title: Interview Razlo

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: If you’re here with another proposition, I’m listening. It was so much fun last time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you’re here with another proposition, I’m listening. It was so much fun last time.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Unless you’re here to offer me a private membership to the Spire Health Spa and Pamper Lounge, I’m not interested.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unless you’re here to offer me a private membership to the Spire Health Spa and Pamper Lounge, I’m not interested.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: And I have a bad case of dermal itch. It’s making me very impatient.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And I have a bad case of dermal itch. It’s making me very impatient.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Of course. He’s like someone gave a cockroach the power of speech.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course. He’s like someone gave a cockroach the power of speech.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: What’s funny is that you have no idea how stupid you are.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What’s funny is that you have no idea how stupid you are.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: So what's this about Danetti?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what's this about Danetti?

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: And you think I’d be interested in anything that grease-trap has to offer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you think I’d be interested in anything that grease-trap has to offer?

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: You might be smarter than you look. Say I did take his recipe, what would you do about it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You might be smarter than you look. Say I did take his recipe, what would you do about it?

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Ha ha. SO funny. And so unwise. We’ll talk again soon. Give my regards to Ava.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha ha. SO funny. And so unwise. We’ll talk again soon. Give my regards to Ava.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: You know, you are far more interesting than I thought. Alright. Keep this between us and I’ll give you 10% of what I get when I sell Danetti's recipe to his competitors.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know, you are far more interesting than I thought. Alright. Keep this between us and I’ll give you 10% of what I get when I sell Danetti's recipe to his competitors.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Too bad for you, then. Give my regards to Ava.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Too bad for you, then. Give my regards to Ava.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: 20% and we have a deal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 20% and we have a deal.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: This has been fun. Come and see me in a few days, partner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This has been fun. Come and see me in a few days, partner.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: You see? Hilarious. This conversation is over. Give my regards to Ava.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You see? Hilarious. This conversation is over. Give my regards to Ava.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: So what's this about Danetti?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what's this about Danetti?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you know Danny Danetti?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know Danny Danetti?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I just have a question.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just have a question.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Funny, I’ve heard that said about you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Funny, I’ve heard that said about you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Funny, I’ve heard that said about you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Funny, I’ve heard that said about you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ha, good one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha, good one.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You won't get under my skin.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You won't get under my skin.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You won't get under my skin.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You won't get under my skin.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're right, I'm sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're right, I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Someone stole his new recipe...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Someone stole his new recipe...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think you know what people value. And how to exploit that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you know what people value. And how to exploit that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think you know what people value. And how to exploit that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think you know what people value. And how to exploit that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Report you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Report you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Depends on what you offer me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Depends on what you offer me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Depends on what you offer me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Depends on what you offer me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No way.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Done.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Done.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think you're a business man who knows a good deal when he sees one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you're a business man who knows a good deal when he sees one.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think you're a business man who knows a good deal when he sees one.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think you're a business man who knows a good deal when he sees one.
